name: NDP MCP Tools
description: National Data Platform (NDP) catalog discovery tools. Source: /u/sislam3/clio-kit/clio-kit-mcp-servers/ndp/src/ndp_mcp/server.py. Backend: http://155.101.6.191:8003. All examples grounded in real API responses captured 2026-05-13.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations (data publishers) that host datasets in the National Data Platform. Read-only. Use this when the user asks who publishes data, wants to browse data providers, or is looking for datasets from a specific institution. Optionally filter by case-insensitive name substring.

parameters.name: name_filter
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter organization names. Omit to list all organizations.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Which NDP catalog to query.

returns.description: Object with `organizations` (list of org name slugs), `count`, `server`, `name_filter` echoed back, and a `_meta` block.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search for datasets in the National Data Platform. Supports two modes: (1) SIMPLE — pass `search_terms` as a list and the backend matches across all fields; (2) ADVANCED — pass any of `dataset_name`, `dataset_title`, `owner_org`, `resource_url`, `resource_name`, `dataset_description`, `resource_description`, `resource_format`, `search_term` (comma-separated terms), `filter_list` (entries like 'key:value'), or `timestamp`. If `search_terms` is provided, the simple GET endpoint is used and other field filters are ignored; otherwise the advanced POST endpoint is used. Use `limit` to cap results (default 20). Returns a list of dataset objects each containing id, name, title, owner_org, notes (description), resources (download/access URLs), and extras (free-form metadata).

parameters.name: search_terms
parameters.description: Simple search terms; matched across all fields. Triggers the GET /search endpoint when present.

parameters.name: search_keys
parameters.description: Optional per-term keys for simple search. Same length as search_terms; use null for global-field match on a given term.

parameters.name: dataset_name
parameters.description: Exact or partial dataset name slug to match.

parameters.name: dataset_title
parameters.description: Substring to match in dataset titles.

parameters.name: owner_org
parameters.description: Organization slug that owns the dataset (use list_organizations to discover valid values).

parameters.name: resource_url
parameters.description: URL substring of a dataset's downloadable resource.

parameters.name: resource_name
parameters.description: Substring to match in resource names within a dataset.

parameters.name: dataset_description
parameters.description: Substring to match in dataset notes/description.

parameters.name: resource_description
parameters.description: Substring to match in a resource's description.

parameters.name: resource_format
parameters.description: Resource format filter (e.g., CSV, JSON, NetCDF, GeoTIFF). Note: the upstream CKAN sometimes returns 502 for raw resource_format searches; prefer filter_list=['resource_format:CSV'] when the direct field fails.

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description: Comma-separated free-text terms searched across all fields (advanced mode).

parameters.name: filter_list
parameters.description: Per-field filters in the form 'key:value' (e.g., ['resource_format:CSV', 'owner_org:nasa-firms']).

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Timestamp filter applied to result freshness.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Which NDP catalog to query.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of datasets to return. Server applies a default cap of 20 if omitted.

returns.description: Object containing `datasets` (list of dataset records with id, name, title, owner_org, notes, resources[], extras{}), `count` (returned), `total_found` (int or 'k of n' string when capped), `server`, the echoed `search_parameters`, and `_meta`.

tools.name: get_dataset_details
tools.description: Retrieve full metadata for a single dataset by its ID (UUID) or name slug. Returns the complete dataset object including the description (`notes`), all `resources` with their download URLs and formats, and the free-form `extras` dictionary with publisher-supplied metadata (e.g., creatorName, dataType, geographic coverage). Use this after search_datasets returns a candidate when the user wants the full details, all resources, or to know how to actually download the data. Raises a ToolError if the identifier doesn't match anything on the specified server.

parameters.name: dataset_identifier
parameters.description: The UUID (when identifier_type='id') or name slug (when identifier_type='name') of the dataset.

parameters.name: identifier_type
parameters.description: How to interpret `dataset_identifier`.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Which NDP catalog to query.

returns.description: Object with the full `dataset` record (id, name, title, owner_org, notes, resources[], extras{}), `identifier_used` echoing back the query, `server`, `resource_count`, and `_meta`.
